query.tested_scope: Browser-only EPA NEPIS keyword search, first15 results. Native document key, publication number/year/pages and exact provider link retained; no full-document download.

licensing: Bounded factual publication metadata and provider links only. Government-hosted publications may include third-party materials; no blanket full-content reuse claim and no book/PDF download. Primary EPA reuse-policy follow-up is tracked separately.
limitations: Browser-only route currently works. Stateless HTTP replay timed out four times; eight remaining jobs were explicitly skipped/interrupted rather than blindly repeated.
One catalog across multiple historical collection indices; date-range index names are not exact publication-year limits. No current-law or all-result recall claim.
Native publication numbers, document keys and years remain distinct; equal titles are not merged.
Full-item PDF/HTML reading and third-party content rights remain unverified; only bounded public metadata was captured.
The EPA privacy notice was captured after its published redirect; it does not supply a blanket content reuse license.
next_action: Working public-browser search after resolving the homepage redirect. Retain the browser route; investigate stateless HTTP only on a useful cookie/session or documented transport finding. Verify published paging and representative item access independently.

analysis_refs.heading: Documentation review limits
analysis_refs.text:
NSDC's sector-council page and the FDIC page returned 403 in this research tool;
EPA NEPIS exposed no readable text. OSTI/MSHA/MARAD deep links were inaccessible,
and the older Forest Service Treesearch URL redirected to its research homepage.
These are unresolved research observations, not claims of service downtime.
Use official directory/root navigation to find current routes; do not turn a
browser restriction into an invented endpoint or relax the source admission gate.
